headline: Fisherman's Row Reopens While Stlican Shelf and Weathered Expanse Trade Strongpoints
war_summary: Since the earlier watch the fighting has shifted. Fisherman's Row, quiet in the last report, has returned with four strongpoint events in the latest two-hour tally and twenty-five in the last day; Arcadia, Black Well, and Eidolo are its most-worked positions. Stlican Shelf added two events in the same short window and nine in six hours, with Fort Hoarfrost the busiest base. Weathered Expanse is also showing fresh movement, three events in the latest two hours, alongside heavy losses on both sides. Godcrofts, the previous edition's pace-setter, has no event in the latest two-hour tally, though it still leads the day's count with fifty-six changes. Stonecradle is active on the six-hour scale but without an event in the two-hour count. Linn Mercy's eight daily changes have likewise cooled. The war remains undecided.
